recommendations.body: `RUNBOOK.md`'s `## Workflow: turn a concept brief into architecture artifacts (roadmap)` section (step 8 "Document the roadmap verb in the operator docs and reconcile BACKLOG #208") states "That's the verb's one non-zero exit", but `cmd_roadmap()` in `plan_tool/cli/roadmap_cmd.py` returns `_RC_USAGE` (2) on every pre-flight failure — an unreadable brief, an out-of-range `--from-stage`, or an upstream artifact that fails its gates — and only `_RC_INCOMPLETE` (1) on an exhausted budget. The same section contradicts itself four paragraphs later by describing a broken hand edit surfacing "as a pre-flight failure, before anything is invoked", and the identical exclusivity claim is restated in `USE_CASES.md` entry 11, `integrations/claude/SKILL.md`'s "Subcommands at a glance" Roadmap row, `CLAUDE.md`'s `**Roadmap (…)**` Architecture paragraph, and `BACKLOG.md` #208's Status line, so an operator or CI keying on the exit code mishandles rc 2 from every doc surface
recommendations.suggested_action: replace the "only non-zero exit" claim at all five sites with the two-code mapping `cmd_roadmap` implements — 1 for an exhausted retry budget, 2 for a pre-flight failure (unreadable brief, out-of-range `--from-stage`, upstream artifact failing its gates)

recommendations.title: `BACKLOG.md` #208's "What" bullet specifies decision-row status as "exactly one status from a closed enum (`settled-by-g
recommendations.body: `BACKLOG.md` #208's "What" bullet specifies decision-row status as "exactly one status from a closed enum (`settled-by-guess` / `pending`)", but `DecisionStatus` in `plan_tool/roadmap_artifacts.py` ships `settled` / `pending`, and `check_decision_records()` reads `status` nowhere. The bullet closes by saying "typed rows are what stages 02–04 and their seeds inherit", so `roadmap-02-components`' seed — authored from this entry, the same path commit `6800decc` re-grounded once already — inherits a value the parser rejects
recommendations.suggested_action: change `settled-by-guess` to `settled` in `BACKLOG.md` #208's "What" bullet to match `roadmap_artifacts.DecisionStatus`

recommendations.body: `RUNBOOK.md`'s "A run that replaced an artifact says so in its summary" paragraph names two of the three lines `_overwrite_summary_lines()` in `plan_tool/cli/roadmap_cmd.py` emits, omitting the `rewritten_again` line that fires whenever a stage at or above the pointer was also overwritten. That is the ordinary case — a full re-run of a populated two-stage directory prints "`--from-stage 2` still rewrites `02-constraints.md` — copy that aside first" — so the doc describes the re-entry pointer as preserving more than it does
recommendations.suggested_action: add the still-rewrites-from-the-pointer-up caveat to `RUNBOOK.md`'s overwrite-summary paragraph
